text: Bliss Glass 是面向 DSH 网页端的主题插件，为界面铺设 Windows XP 风格的风景壁纸，并将聊天框、菜单、对话框和侧栏处理为半透明磨砂玻璃。客户端在页面加入壁纸选择器与明暗主题按钮，可切换内置或导入的图片，也可选择纯玻璃或关闭壁纸；导入图片会在浏览器中缩放并压缩，选择会保存在本地。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页界面外观的用户，按已读实现评估。

Bliss Glass themes the DSH web UI with XP-era scenery wallpapers and frosted-glass panels. Choose bundled or imported images, switch to glass-only mode, turn the wallpaper off, and toggle light or dark appearance. Imported images are resized in the browser and preferences are stored locally.
想给 DSH 网页界面换成 XP 时代的风景壁纸。
有没有能把聊天框和侧栏变成磨砂玻璃效果的主题？
我想在 DSH 里导入自己的图片当背景。
让 DSH 网页界面能快速切换浅色和深色主题。
我想只保留透明玻璃面板，不显示背景壁纸。
How can I personalize the DSH web UI with scenery wallpapers?
I want frosted-glass panels and a quick light/dark toggle in DSH.
Bliss Glass 的功能「壁纸切换」：点击页面角落的壁纸按钮，在菜单中选择内置风景或已导入图片，并可切换为纯玻璃或关闭壁纸；当前选择会保存到浏览器本地。
Bliss Glass 的功能「导入自定义壁纸」：在壁纸菜单中选择本地图片，客户端用浏览器 canvas 缩放并编码为 JPEG，再加入可选壁纸列表并保存在本地。
Bliss Glass 的功能「明暗主题切换」：点击主题按钮，通过 DSH theme 服务切换浅色或深色外观，并根据页面主题状态更新界面样式。
DSH 网页背景能不能用我自己的照片？

Bliss Glass

Theme for DeepSeek Harness · DeepSeek Harness 主题

Where XP nostalgia meets liquid glass.
当 XP 的怀旧风景，遇见现代的液态玻璃。

简体中文 · English

dsh-bliss-glass README · English：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) theme built on a simple contrast: the sun-lit, natural scenery wallpapers of the Windows XP era as the desktop backdrop — and every panel of the web UI rendered as modern frosted glass on top of it.

dsh-bliss-glass README · English：The two halves are deliberate. The wallpaper keeps its colors and calm; the interface becomes translucent, blurred glass — composer, menus, dialogs, bubbles, sidebars — each with a white hairline and a specular highlight, following your light and dark themes. It reads equally well on the desktop surface and on the mobile web UI.

dsh-bliss-glass README · ✨ Features：|  | English | 中文 |
|---|---|---|
| 🧊 | **Frosted-glass panels** — composer, menus, dialogs, bubbles, sidebars, toasts; blurred backdrop, white hairline, specular highlight | **精美玻璃质感** — 聊天框、菜单、对话框、气泡、侧栏全覆盖 |
| 🖼 | **Dynamic wallpapers** — four bundled sceneries, plus import any image (auto-downscaled & recompressed in-browser) | **动态背景支持** — 内置四张风景，任意图片自动处理后即插即用 |
| 🌗 | **Light / dark toggle** — switches through the official theme service; preference persisted | **明暗一键切换** — 官方主题服务，偏好持久化 |
| 📱 | **Desktop & mobile** — pure CSS; works on the mobile web UI out of the box | **桌面与移动端** — 纯 CSS 实现，开箱即用 |
| 🪶 | **Light & easy** — no build step, no dependencies, no host files touched | **轻量易安装** — 无构建、零依赖、不改宿主文件 |

dsh-bliss-glass README · 📦 Install：**Desktop app (recommended)** — open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste the repository URL below, and confirm. No profile needs to be chosen; the app targets its own profile for you.

```
https://github.com/ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

**Desktop, from the command line** — use the `dsh` that ships with the desktop app. `--profile` is required and must come **before** the pnpm arguments:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

dsh-bliss-glass README · 📦 Install：**Web / other profiles** — same command with the profile you boot:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

> Running the desktop app? Quit it completely before installing from the command line — the `desktop` profile belongs to the app, and the app rewrites it on exit.

**dsh-market** — or one click from the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) **Themes** tab.

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🧭 Wallpaper picker：Click the small glass button in the bottom-right corner: a menu opens with thumbnails of every wallpaper — pick one, import any image from disk or your phone's gallery, switch to a glass-only mode, or turn the wallpaper off entirely. Your choice, imported images and theme preference all persist across restarts.

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🔍 How it works (for reviewers)：The client module renders a fixed background layer and applies the frosted styling through DSH **theme tokens** (`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-*`, `--dsw-specific-*`) plus a small set of element rules matched against this build's panel classes (`RlGAzG_card`, `Xt1eiG_panel`, …). The wallpaper picker downscales and re-encodes imported images with a canvas in the browser; imported images are stored in `localStorage`. No host files are modified and no data leaves the machine.

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🔍 How it works (for reviewers)：> Panel class hooks are matched against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.x`. On other builds the wallpaper and token layer keep working; the hashed-class refinements may need a selector update.

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🗑 Uninstall：Remove the plugin from the Plugin Manager, or (quit the app first):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-bliss-glass
```

dsh-bliss-glass README · 中文：一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 主题插件，建立在一场刻意的相遇之上：Windows XP 年代阳光下的自然风光做桌面底色，Web 界面的每一块面板在其上化作现代的磨砂玻璃。

两半各有坚持。壁纸保留它的色彩与安宁；界面化为半透明、带背景模糊的玻璃——聊天框、菜单、对话框、气泡、侧栏，每一块都有白色细描边与一道顶部高光，跟随你的明暗主题。在桌面上，在手机的浏览器里，观感一致。

dsh-bliss-glass README · ✨ 特色：|  | 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 🧊 | **精美玻璃质感** | 聊天框、菜单、对话框、气泡、侧栏、Toast 全覆盖：背景模糊 + 白描边 + 顶部高光 |
| 🖼 | **动态背景支持** | 内置四张高清风景；任意图片自动缩放压缩后即插即用 |
| 🌗 | **明暗一键切换** | 走官方主题服务，偏好持久化 |
| 📱 | **桌面与移动端** | 纯 CSS 实现，移动版 Web 界面开箱即用 |
| 🪶 | **轻量易安装** | 无构建、零依赖、不改宿主文件 |

dsh-bliss-glass README · 📦 安装：**桌面应用（推荐）**——打开应用内 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴下面的仓库地址并确认。不需要选择 profile，应用会自动对接到自己的配置。

```
https://github.com/ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

**桌面端命令行**——使用桌面版自带的 `dsh`。`--profile` 是必填项，且必须写在 pnpm 参数**之前**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

**Web / 其他配置**——换成你实际启动的 profile 名称即可：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
```

> 若正在运行桌面应用，命令行安装前请先**完全退出应用**——`desktop` 配置由应用本身管理，退出时会被应用改写。
dsh-bliss-glass README · 📦 安装：**dsh-market**——或在 [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) 的**主题**分类中一键安装。
dsh-bliss-glass README · 🧭 壁纸切换器：点击右下角的小玻璃按钮：弹出缩略图菜单——选一张内置壁纸、导入任意本地图片或手机相册图片、切到无壁纸的「纯玻璃」模式，或干脆关掉壁纸。你的选择、导入的图片与主题偏好重启后都在。

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🔍 实现方式（供评审参考）：Client 模块渲染一层固定背景，并通过 DSH **主题 token**（`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-*`、`--dsw-specific-*`）与少量元素规则应用磨砂样式；元素规则优先用 DSH 自带的稳定语义钩子（`data-composer-card`、`data-composer-seat`、`data-conversation-region="chat"`、`data-shell-overlay`）与 CSS Modules 的类名后缀（`_bubble`、`_sidebarCol`），不再依赖每次发版都会变的哈希前缀。壁纸切换器在浏览器内用 canvas 对导入图片降采样并重新编码；导入的图片存于 `localStorage`。不修改任何宿主文件，数据不出本机。

> 面板钩子对 CSS Modules 哈希变化免疫：稳定属性与类名后缀不随发版改变，已测构建的哈希仅作为回退保留。只有当 DSH 改变这些属性的结构/语义时，才需要更新选择器。

dsh-bliss-glass README · 🗑 卸载：在插件管理器中移除，或（先退出应用）： ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-bliss-glass ``` ---
The wallpaper keeps its calm; the interface keeps its clarity.
壁纸守住它的安宁，界面守住它的清透。
